topology.description: Reduced forward-wave circuit: posterior touch initiates A27h-like premotor activity; each premotor excites a segment motor pool and a local PMSI-like inhibitory termination pool; shortening-sensitive proprioception excites the next anterior premotor pool.
limitations: Not a complete brain or VNC connectome.
The reduced proprioceptor-to-next-premotor edge is a circuit-level approximation, not a claimed identified monosynaptic connection.
One bilateral longitudinal motor pool represents many neurons and muscles per segment.
Each PMSI-like pool is a reduced inhibitory termination motif, not a claim that one identified neuron or monosynaptic edge implements the entire segmental off-switch.

parameter_provenance.objective: Produce a stable posterior-to-anterior neural and contraction wave whose adjacent motor-onset phase delays fall inside the Greaney 2026 L1 animal-level p10-p90 bands; add a fitted PMSI-like inhibitory termination motif; and expose contraction amplitude, rate, and duration failures without disguising them as validation.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: The 2.5 s cycle period, reduced relay delays, 2 ms PMSI recruitment, and inhibitory current are MODEL_FITTED because the checked-in target does not identify these reduced-circuit parameters. The PMSI delay is not claimed as a measured L1 single-synapse latency. Contraction amplitude, shortening rate, and duration remain outside target bands. Other numeric neural, sensory, activation, adaptation, and contact parameters remain engineering estimates; none is a measured L1 constant.
